findings.detail: The doctor's --required-migration gate correctly fails closed (exit 1) when the ledger is behind. Logic: parses REQUIRED_MIGRATION env or --required-migration flag, finds the journal entry, compares highestAppliedWhen against requiredEntry.when. When behind, counts entries with e.when > highestAppliedWhen && e.idx >= requiredEntry.idx and reports 'Required migration behind count: N'. When current, prints 'Required migration gate OK'. When tag not in journal (typo), exits 1 with 'behind count: 0'. When no flag/env is set, gate is skipped entirely (backward compat). No off-by-one: the behind count correctly includes the required entry itself when it's not applied.

selectLessonsToInsert(existingLessons, canonicalLessons) keys dedup on order (not type). Returns canonical lessons whose order is not in existingOrders set. Production code in seed() selects {type, order, title} from codecampLessons for existing modules and delegates to this helper. Existing lesson rows are never deleted — 'don't disrupt student progress' preserved. The test imports the REAL helper from ../seed/codecamp-seed.js (not a local mirror). Test simulates first-per-type-already-present scenario and asserts wronglySkippedLessonCount === 0. A4 vacuity guards: 'Fixture module count must be > 0', 'At least one module must have multiple lessons of the same type'. Curriculum data has 68 theory lessons across ~17 modules — guard is meaningful.

All 10 lesson files converted from bare LessonContent to LessonsFile wrapper ({framework, gradeLevel, unit, lessons: [{id, slug, title, description, content, order, standards, structuredContent}]}). All 10 question files converted to QuizQuestionsFile wrapper ({lessonId, questions: [{type, text, options, correctAnswer, points, standards, slug}]}). Content preserved: structuredContent blocks verbatim (9-10 blocks per file), vocabulary terms with thai translations intact, 20 questions per file. Seed validation (validateLessonsSeedFile/validateQuizQuestionsSeedFile) runs Zod safeParse BEFORE any insert. Pre-existing tests updated: content-migration.test.ts reads via content.lessons?.[0] path, curriculum-identifiers.test.ts reads via data.lessons?.[0]?.structuredContent path. Assertion intent preserved (slug validity, 10 lessons, bilingual vocab, 20 questions).

Module upsert now SELECTs existing by slug first, reuses id on re-seed, only INSERTs for new modules. Lesson upsert SELECTs by (moduleId, order), updates if exists, inserts if new. No 'fallback-id' sentinel — throw on failed insert instead. No schoolId introduced (single-tenant/global verified by source scan). Test's simulateSalesSeedRuns mirrors production upsert logic. Three tests: (1) no orphan lessons, (2) all lessons reviewStatus='draft', (3) source has no schoolId.

All count assertions use labeled integers: 'Wrongly-skipped canonical lesson count: N', 'Missing sentinel count: N', 'Orphan lesson count: N', 'Draft-visible lesson count: N', 'Invalid grade-4 seed item count: N'. No bare-digit matching.

Vacuity guards present in all seed tests: 'Fixture module count must be > 0', 'At least one module must have multiple lessons of the same type', 'Grade-4 lesson fixture file count must be > 0', 'Grade-4 question fixture file count must be > 0'. Grade-4 fixtures verified: 10 lesson files, 10 question files, all with real content. Codecamp curriculum data verified: 68 theory, 17 quiz, 1 exercise lessons across phases A-D.
